title: Schedule
description: Plan shifts, resolve conflicts and publish the roster.

dialog.publishMessage: {{count}} draft shifts between {{range}} become visible to employees, and they get a notification.
dialog.publishNothing: There are no draft shifts to publish in this week.
dialog.copyMessage: All shifts of the week before {{range}} are copied here as drafts. Shifts already in this week stay, so you may get duplicates.
dialog.deleteMessage: The shift cannot be restored after you delete it.

grid.dropHint: Drop here to place the shift
grid.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see the whole week.

shift.dragHint: Drag to move, or press Enter to edit.

editor.teamHint: Open shifts belong to a team.
editor.notePlaceholder: For example: opening duty, training day
editor.conflictsHint: You can still save, but check these first.

problems.timeRequired: Enter a start and an end time (HH:mm).
problems.sameTime: Start and end time cannot be the same.
problems.breakTooLong: The break must be shorter than the shift.

conflicts.overlap: Overlaps with another shift of this employee.
conflicts.absence: The employee has an approved or pending absence on this day.
conflicts.unavailableDay: The employee is not available on this weekday.
conflicts.unavailableHours: The shift is outside the employee's available hours.
conflicts.overHours: The week goes over the contract hours.

palette.title: Shift templates
palette.hint: Drag a template onto a day to add a draft shift. The Add shift buttons do the same from the keyboard.
palette.dragLabel: Template {{name}}, {{start}} to {{end}}. Drag onto a day, or use Add shift.

state.emptyMessage: Add a shift, drag a template onto a day, or copy last week's roster.
state.emptyEmployee: Nothing has been published for this week yet.
state.errorMessage: Check your connection and try again.

announce.copied: {{count}} shifts copied from the previous week as drafts.

undone.create: The shift could not be added.
undone.move: The shift could not be moved and is back where it was.
undone.resize: The shift end could not be changed and is back to the old time.
undone.edit: The shift could not be saved and shows the old values again.
undone.delete: The shift could not be deleted and is back in the roster.

toast.publishedMessage: {{count}} shifts are now visible to employees.
toast.copiedMessage: {{count}} draft shifts were added to this week.
